CPT: 99213-25 (mandatory E/M with -25), 64455-RT, 64455-LT-59, 77002 (fluoro guidance), 97760 (orthotic management/training). HCPCS: L3020-RT, L3020-LT (corrected from L3000), J0702 x2 units (corrected from 4 units). PMH conditions (anxiety, allergic rhinitis) retained as supporting_conditions only. Key corrections: added mandatory E/M with -25, corrected L3000→L3020 per coding policy, corrected J0702 units to reflect proper 6mg-per-unit dosing.
